answer: 2023-24: 2,208 LEAs were surveyed and 1,579 responses were recorded—about 72% of all surveyed LEAs. After excluding 385 LEAs that said they did not offer TK, the report states 1,579 responses out of 1,823 remaining LEAs, or 87%. 2024-25: 1,464 LEAs were surveyed and 952 responses were recorded—about 65%. After 26 LEAs reported no TK program, 926 of the remaining LEAs (95%) indicated they had at least one TK program; this 95% figure is program-status participation, not a stated response rate. Thus, the 2024-25 survey covered 744 fewer LEAs, recorded 627 fewer responses, and had a stated overall rate 7 percentage points lower than 2023-24.
